item.title: Australia has so much solar that it's offering everyone free electricity
item.description:
📝 Solar power Australia Australia has so much solar that it’s offering everyone free electricity Jameson Dow | Nov 4 2025 - 11:16 am PT 41 Comments Wemen Solar Farm, Victoria, Australia. But it can lead to swingy electricity supply, given that solar only generates electricity when the sun is out. In Australia and other places with high solar penetration, these negative electricity prices often happen during the day.
